# Safepipe changelog (plan-linked build log) Implementation Plan

**Goal:** A `changelog.html` build log in safepipe_proj, styled in this project's own light design system (pitch-page idiom), showing every plan as cards with a calendar heat graph, tag chips, day filter, phase/task rail, commit-timeline detail drawer, and an unlinked-commits triage block — ported from the proven changelog-kit implementation running in crm_proj / personal_website.

**Architecture:** Static manifest (`src/ds/plan-manifest.json`, already generated by `scripts/plan-track.mjs` on every build) + vanilla JS modules under `src/changelog/` (pure parse/link layers + DOM views) inlined with plan markdown via `import.meta.glob('../../.hermes/plans/*.md?raw')`. Zero backend. Safepipe adapter: plans use `## Task N` / `### Task N` headings (not `## Phase N`), and commit anchors are bare `task-N` — the parse layer synthesizes sections and `{#task-N}` tokens, and anchor matching is digit-boundary aware (`task-1` never hits `task-10`).

**Tech Stack:** Vite MPA (existing, new `changelog` entry), vanilla JS modules, `design-system/tokens.css` as the only visual source (page-local `--cl-*` vars bridged via `calc()` off `--sp-*`, no raw hex/px).

**Tags:** Tooling, Design System

## Task 5: Data-sanity pass ✓ done

**Objective:** Triage empty, every plan visible, no phantom tasks.

**Fixes (all found in review):**
- `norm()` synthesized open checkboxes from non-task `###` subsections (`### Risks / tradeoffs` made the changelog card read 3/4) — non-task subsections now pass through verbatim; changelog plan reads 4/4.
- `split()` fallback dropped any plan with a prose `##` before its first `###`, hiding production-ready's 10 genuine tasks — guard removed (SECTION filter already drops non-task heads); now 7 cards.
- Tracker `TRACKED` missed `src/changelog`, page html, `scripts`, `public` — 3 trailer-carrying changelog commits + sidebar commit were invisible to the log; widened to `['src','design-system','docs','scripts','public','*.html','vite.config.js','package.json']`.
- Added retro support to tracker + `src/ds/plan-retro.json` (7 pre-trailer commits) — 55/55 linked, triage empty.
- Fixed `wip` parse (`slice(3)` ate a path char on short prefixes) — `slice(2).trimStart()`.

**Verify:** `plan-track` 55 commits / 55 linked / 0 unlinked; `npm run build` green; known exception: `b33f7a9` (plan-tracking hygiene, touches only `.hermes`+`.gitignore`) stays outside TRACKED by design.

### Risks / tradeoffs
- Plan markdown with fenced code blocks containing `## ` lines: handled by fence-aware `chunks()`.
- `production-ready` groups `### Task` under prose `##` heads: covered by the relaxed fallback (renders flat, 10 tasks) — no phase-grouping is preserved, by design.
- Detail markdown renderer is minimal (no fenced-code highlighting): matches the reference implementation; revisit only if unreadable.

## Task 6: Plan-iteration history (foolproof + backpropagated) ✓ done

**Objective:** Task edits (added/renamed/reworded/reordered) visible in the log with zero new habits.

**Design:**
- Tracker appends to `src/ds/plan-history.json` (`{file: [{sha, date, hash, sections:[{head, hash, state}]}]}`) whenever current plan hash is unseen — rides the existing predev/build hook, so capture needs no convention beyond building.
- `scripts/plan-backfill.mjs` walks `git log --follow` per plan, rehashes each committed version, merges dedupe-by-hash — idempotent, rerunnable; thin today (plans tracked only since `b33f7a9`) but complete going forward.
- Cards show `· rev <n> <last-date>`; rail rows show `· edited` when that section hash changed across versions.

**Verify:** history file covers all 7 plans; rerun tracker diff-clean; backfill rerun adds 0; build green.

## Task 8: Per-plan revision list in the changelog views ✓ done

**Objective:** The owner can open any plan and see every revision (r1…rN with date, per-section heads + states, changed-since-previous marks) — not just `rev N` counts. Owner steer 2026-10-12: "i need to see all the iterations done per plan".

**Design:**
- Detail drawer (or card expansion — lane picks the surface that fits existing view roles): a revisions block per plan, newest-first or oldest-first to match history order, each row `rN · date`, expanding to section heads + `state` with a changed mark when the section hash differs from the previous rev (same rule as rail `· edited`).
- Data comes from the already-bundled `plan-history.json` (see `references/iterations.md` import-depth note); no new data plumbing, no tracker changes.
- Styling follows the host changelog visual language (tokens only); prototype reference (scratch, not shipped): `/Users/irfan/.hermes/cache/scratch/plan-iterations.html`.

**Verify:** every plan with >1 rev shows its full list; rev counts match history; section states match live parse; build green; existing changelog tests pass.

## Task 9: Revisions block — above commits, compact scrollable list ✓ done

**Objective:** Owner steer 2026-10-12 on the Task 8 block: it must sit BEFORE the commit history, read as a compact scrollable list, never an accordion.

**Design (redirected by owner steer 2026-10-12 — supersedes the accordion/list draft below):**
- Revisions block sits above the commit timeline (order: phases/sections → Revisions → commits) and flows FLAT in the drawer's own scroll — no nested scroll container.
- Content is the feedback of each revision, newest-first, not rev names/numbers: each entry is dated and leads with what changed — changed sections with old→new state transitions (e.g. "Phase 02 · 1/6 → 6/6 · changed"); unchanged sections collapse to a quiet count line.
- Keep `data-revs` / `data-rev` / `data-changed` attributes; token-only styling.

**Superseded draft (kept for the record):**
- Move the `paintRevs` block above the commit timeline in the drawer (order: phases/sections → Revisions → commits).
- Replace native `<details>` accordion with a compact flat list in a max-height scroll container: one tight row per rev (`rN · date · n sections`, changed-section count inline), section heads + states + changed marks visible inline without expanding.
- Keep `data-revs` / `data-rev` / `data-changed` attributes so the list stays probeable; token-only styling.

**Verify:** revisions render above commits; all rows visible via scroll with no expand step; rev counts + changed marks unchanged vs Task 8; build green; 0 page errors.

## Task 10: Revisions as semantic feedback — date, time, what changed ✓ done

**Objective:** Owner steer 2026-10-12 with screenshot: each revision must read as date + time + a semantic summary of what was requested/changed — no left indentation on section lines, no status words (no "new / changed" marks).

**Design:**
- Entry header: date + time (e.g. "12 Oct 2026 · 21:47"). History entries today carry date only — extend the tracker (`scripts/plan-track.mjs`) to stamp `time` (HH:MM local) on new snapshots, keeping `date` untouched for back-compat; old revs render date-only. Optional: backfill times from git commit timestamps where a rev maps to a commit (`scripts/plan-backfill.mjs`).
- Entry body: zero indentation everywhere (date line, summary lines, all at the same left edge), one step smaller than drawer body text (quiet metadata size, token scale). One plain-language line per changed section derived from the diff — task-count transitions ("Phase 02 — 5 tasks closed, 1/6 → 6/6"), done markings ("Tasks 10–14 marked done"), renames ("renamed 'X' → 'Y'"), body edits ("edited"), new sections ("added"). Drop the `· new` / `· changed` marks and the "N unchanged" line entirely — the summary lines carry the meaning.
- Optional enrichment (lane's call, only if clean): pull the linked commit subjects for the plan+anchor from `plan-manifest.json` as the "requested" line. Never invent summaries — every line traces to a hash diff or a real commit.
- Keep `data-revs` / `data-rev` / `data-changed` attributes; token-only styling.

**Verify:** no indented rows; no "new/changed" strings in the block; every entry shows date (+time where recorded); each summary line traces to a real diff or commit; tracker rerun diff-clean; build green; 0 page errors.

## Task 11: Revisions surface the review feedback itself (starts after Lane J lands)

**Objective:** Owner steer 2026-10-12 with screenshot: revision entries should show the FEEDBACK GIVEN IN REVIEW for that phase — the actual critique content (e.g. a "Feedback pass" task's bullets: blips sizes down, terrain glow values, relief changes) — not task-counter transitions. Applies to all plans: wherever a phase's history contains review-feedback sections, the revision feed quotes them.

**Design (for the lane that picks this up after Lane J):**
- Detect feedback-type sections (head matching feedback/review/pass language) and changed bullets inside them; entry lines quote or tightly summarize the changed bullets (values included: "orbit min 0.05→0.5", "VEX 3.2→4.5").
- Non-feedback changes keep the Task 10 transition lines. Same format rules: date + time, flush-left, small, no status words.
- Never invent feedback — every quoted line traces to a real section diff.

**Verify:** a plan with recorded review feedback (e.g. 153000 Ops3D v2) shows the feedback bullets in its revision entries; lines trace to diffs; build green; 0 page errors.
